reasoning: config.py only calls toml.load on a file path. tomllib.load does the same job from the standard library, but needs the file opened in binary mode. tomllib only exists on Python 3.11+, while pyproject.toml still allows 3.10, so the support range must be raised or a tomli fallback added.

alternatives.name: tomli
alternatives.why_not: works on 3.10 but keeps a third-party dependency

alternatives.name: tomlkit
alternatives.why_not: heavier; only needed for round-trip editing
